name: CARE
tagline: ML-powered automated generation of chemical reaction networks in heterogeneous catalysis
description: CARE (_Catalytic Automated Reaction Evaluator_) is a framework for the automated generation and manipulation of chemical reaction networks (CRNs) in heterogeneous catalysis. CARE is powered by ML-based energy evaluators (GAME-Net-UQ, FairChem, MACE, Orb, SevenNet) and includes multiscale kinetic functionalities enabling the quantification of catalytic activity for reactions containing thousands of elementary steps.
